_comment: Hand-authored fixes applied ON TOP OF data/deck_data.json at page-build time. Keys are the unit id and the slide number as shown in the site (1-based). Regenerating deck_data.json from the .pptx files does NOT touch this file. If you insert or delete slides in a deck, re-check the slide numbers here. Supported keys per slide: title (string, \n allowed on divider slides), caption (string, shown under the first image), diagram (see build), dropTables (bool), dropImages (bool), hideAsides (bool).

_config._hint: hidden: unit ids not shown on the site (no index row, no nav). hiddenPages: standalone pages (glossary, accounts) whose footer link is hidden. In both cases the content still builds and is reachable by direct URL for previewing. Empty a list to publish.
